title: OJCP Agent Identity Document
description: Schema for the /.well-known/ojcp-agent.json document served by the host an agent_id names (for com.acme.agent, agent.acme.com). It authorizes Signature-Agent origins outside the agent_id's own namespace to sign as that agent_id. See spec § Delegated Binding.

agent_id.description: The agent_id this document authorizes signers for. MUST equal, byte for byte, the agent_id whose reversed labels name the serving host.

items.description: An authorized Signature-Agent origin, as an ASCII serialization per RFC 6454 §6.2: lowercase, https, no path, no trailing slash.

signers.description: Signature-Agent origins authorized to sign requests as agent_id. Removing an origin revokes it once cached copies expire.
